name: Acura Integra GS-R (third generation)
h1: Acura Integra GS-R (DC2, 1994–2001): specs, B18C VTEC engine and what owners say

nhtsa.note: NHTSA files every Integra under INTEGRA, so these counts include the LS, GS, RS and Type R and both body styles, not just the GS-R.

us.x: Sold new in the US for model years 1994 to 2001. The Type R was sold for 1997 and 1998 and again for 2000 and 2001.

films.x: Edwin races Brian and Dom in the film's opening street race in a 1996 Integra GS-R. It was the production's number one hero car, rented from the customizer who built it.

Mia drives a blue 1994 Integra sedan with a Japanese-market front end and takes Brian out in it after a dinner date to show off her driving. Reports differ on the trim: some call it a GS-R, CarThrottle says it was a lower-spec LS.

gens.tag: 1.8-liter B18C1 DOHC VTEC, 170 hp at 7,600 rpm and an 8,000 rpm redline. Type R: 195 hp.

variants.name: Integra GS-R
variants.what: The VTEC engine with an 8,000 rpm redline, offered as a coupe and, for the first time, a sedan.

variants.name: Integra Type R

weight.note: Hagerty; Acura says 33 lb lighter than a GS-R

variants.what: Its own hand-built B18C5 engine (ported head, 10.6:1 compression), a seam-welded body and a limited-slip front differential. About 2,600 were sold in North America each year.

B18C1.name: Honda B18C1
facts: 170 hp at 7,600 rpm, 128 lb-ft at 6,200 rpm
1,797 cc, 81 x 87.2 mm bore x stroke

issues.rx: oil consumption|burn(s|ing)? oil|using oil|blue smoke|smok(e|ing) from (the )?(tail|exhaust)
issues.x: Hagerty's buyer's guide says many of these high-revving engines were driven hard and can burn oil. Look for tailpipe smoke after a long idle and check the dipstick.
The owners and experts in Hagerty's buyer's guide say the timing belt and water pump should be replaced together every 90,000 miles.
issues.fix: Replace the timing belt and water pump together at 90,000 miles.

issues.x: For a time the 1999 Integra was the most stolen car in America, per Hagerty, and the 1994 Integra was eighth on the NICB's 2010 list. Some GS-R and Type R cars have had their VTEC engines stolen or swapped for non-VTEC ones.

facts: 195 hp at 8,000 rpm, 130 lb-ft at 7,300 rpm
